title: Weather Bureau Monthly Summary form (handwritten, scanned)

reportMonth.description: the name of the month written on the blank in the summary header line

reportYear.description: the four-digit year printed or written in the summary header line

observerName.description: the observer's name as signed on the signature blank at the bottom of the form

meanActualPressure.description: handwritten value in the 'mean actual' pressure blank under atmospheric pressure

meanActualPressure8am.description: handwritten value in the 8 a.m. blank on the mean actual pressure line

meanActualPressure8pm.description: handwritten value in the 8 p.m. blank on the mean actual pressure line

meanReducedPressure.description: handwritten value in the 'mean reduced' pressure blank

meanReducedPressure8am.description: handwritten value in the 8 a.m. blank on the mean reduced pressure line

meanReducedPressure8pm.description: handwritten value in the 8 p.m. blank on the mean reduced pressure line

highestActualPressure.description: handwritten value in the 'highest actual' pressure blank

highestActualPressureDay.description: day-of-month on which the highest actual pressure occurred, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

lowestActualPressure.description: handwritten value in the 'lowest' actual pressure blank

lowestActualPressureDay.description: day-of-month on which the lowest actual pressure occurred, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

actualPressureRange.description: handwritten value in the actual-pressure absolute range blank

highestReducedPressure.description: handwritten value in the 'highest reduced' pressure blank

lowestReducedPressure.description: handwritten value in the 'lowest' reduced pressure blank

reducedPressureRange.description: handwritten value in the reduced-pressure absolute range blank

meanTemperature.description: handwritten value in the 'mean (max. and min.)' temperature blank

meanMaxTemperature.description: handwritten value in the 'mean maximum' temperature blank

meanMinTemperature.description: handwritten value in the 'mean minimum' temperature blank

temperature8am.description: handwritten value in the 8 a.m. temperature blank

temperature8pm.description: handwritten value in the 8 p.m. temperature blank

highestTemperature.description: handwritten value in the 'highest' temperature blank

highestTemperatureDay.description: day-of-month on which the highest temperature occurred, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

lowestTemperature.description: handwritten value in the 'lowest' temperature blank

lowestTemperatureDay.description: day-of-month on which the lowest temperature occurred, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

temperatureRange.description: handwritten value in the temperature absolute range blank

greatestDailyRange.description: handwritten value in the 'greatest daily range' blank

greatestDailyRangeDay.description: day-of-month of the greatest daily range, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

leastDailyRange.description: handwritten value in the 'least' daily range blank

leastDailyRangeDay.description: day-of-month of the least daily range, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

totalPrecipitation.description: handwritten value in the total precipitation blank, in inches

greatest24HourPrecipitation.description: handwritten value for greatest precipitation in any 24 consecutive hours, in inches

greatest24HourPrecipitationDay.description: day-of-month of the greatest 24-hour precipitation, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

totalWindMovement.description: handwritten value in the total wind movement blank, in miles

maxWindVelocity.description: handwritten value in the maximum wind velocity blank

maxWindDirection.description: the compass direction written next to the maximum wind velocity, as a compass abbreviation

maxWindDay.description: day-of-month on which the maximum wind velocity occurred, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

windObservationsN.description: handwritten count of observations blowing from the N in the wind-direction tally line

windObservationsNE.description: handwritten count of observations blowing from the NE in the wind-direction tally line

windObservationsE.description: handwritten count of observations blowing from the E in the wind-direction tally line

windObservationsSE.description: handwritten count of observations blowing from the SE in the wind-direction tally line

windObservationsS.description: handwritten count of observations blowing from the S in the wind-direction tally line

windObservationsSW.description: handwritten count of observations blowing from the SW in the wind-direction tally line

windObservationsW.description: handwritten count of observations blowing from the W in the wind-direction tally line

windObservationsNW.description: handwritten count of observations blowing from the NW in the wind-direction tally line

windObservationsCalm.description: handwritten count in the 'calm' slot of the wind-direction tally line

averageCloudiness.description: handwritten value in the 'average cloudiness (0 to 10)' blank

averageCloudiness8am.description: handwritten value in the 8 a.m. average cloudiness blank

averageCloudiness8pm.description: handwritten value in the 8 p.m. average cloudiness blank

cloudlessDays.description: handwritten count in the 'number of cloudless days' blank

partlyCloudyDays.description: handwritten count in the 'partly cloudy' days blank on the cloudiness summary line

cloudyDays.description: handwritten count in the 'cloudy' days blank on the cloudiness summary line

totalDaysWithRainfall.description: handwritten value in the 'total days with rainfall' blank

averageSnowDepthEndOfMonth.description: handwritten value in the 'average depth of snow on ground at end of month' blank, in inches

highestRiverLevel.description: handwritten value in the 'highest water in river (ft. and tenths)' blank

highestRiverDay.description: day-of-month of the highest river level, as an integer ignoring any ordinal suffix

lowestRiverLevel.description: handwritten value in the 'lowest' river level blank

solarHalos.description: handwritten count in the 'dates of solar halos' blank; use the number written even when it is zero

lunarHalos.description: handwritten count in the 'lunar halos' blank; use the number written even when it is zero

monthlyMeanDewPoint.description: handwritten value written for monthly mean dew point in the phenomena section

monthlyMeanRelativeHumidity.description: handwritten value written for monthly mean relative humidity in the phenomena section
